title: sphaerocionium lobatoalatum
intro: Sphaerocionium lobatoalatum, commonly known as the Lobed Liverwort, is a species of liverwort, a non-vascular, thalloid plant that belongs to the family Lepidoziaceae. The health benefits of Sphaerocionium lobatoalatum include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may contribute to its therapeutic use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Sphaerocionium lobatoalatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, among others, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
